raw_segments.text: That's true, that's true, yes, both true enough.
But you must jump when he gives an order.
Step and growl, growl and go, that's the word with Captain Ahab.
But nothing about that thing that happened to him off Cape Horn, long ago,
when he lay like dead for three days and nights.
Nothing about that deadly scrimmage with the Spaniard before the altar in Santa.
Nothing about the silver calabash he spat into.
And nothing about his losing his leg last voyage, according to the prophecy.
Didn't he hear a word about the matters and something more, eh?
No, I don't think he did, how could ye?
But howsoever, Mahap, ye have heard tell about the leg and how he lost it.
I ye have heard of that, I dare say.
Oh yes, that everyone knows the most.
I mean they know he's only one leg, and that a parmosetty took the other off.
